scope: Daskam folders with numbered local reference images; preserve existing approved D001 landscapes

output_contract.versioning: Never overwrite existing candidates, masters, or comparison copies; record approval in manifests, not filename.
output_contract.resolution: Highest available native resolution; record actual dimensions, no cropping or artificial enlargement.

gates: Approve dedicated reference sheets for recurring characters before batch production.
Review reference-to-stanza mapping; image sequence does not always equal stanza number.
Read chapter visual plan and relevant character bibles before each generation.
Review landscape before generating its independently composed portrait companion.
Only explicit user approval changes approval manifests.
